correctness.rationale: For a fixed pair, the Markov intersection count is lumpable until first hit into states 0,1. Direct delete/insert counting gives Q=[[1−a,a],[b,1−b−c]] with a=2/(n−r),b=(n−r−1)/(r(n−r)),c=(r−1)/(r(n−r)); its positive Perron vector (1,h) bounds survival from above/below. Summation over all m pairs gives E U_t inequalities; Markov union bound and geometric tail give only the expected cover-time limsup upper constant. Independent full-state rational transition checks verified 5≤n≤8 in selected r cases and six finite horizons. No lower cover-time constant, limiting Gumbel law, or r-growing asymptotic is proved.
residual_risks: Sharp one-sided upper limit only; no matching lower asymptotic, Gumbel law, joint multi-pair avoidance or growing-r uniformity.
